action_items: (low) Add aria-describedby/Description to the Contractor New dialog (shadcn DialogContent) to silence the a11y console warning.
(observation) Reconcile endpoint always returns ok:true regardless of FTP config — consider returning ok:false with message when not configured, since current behaviour is opaque to UI.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.py POST /ftp/reconcile spawns asyncio.create_task and returns immediately; if reconcile_on_startup raises, error is swallowed. Acceptable for best-effort, but log task exceptions via task.add_done_callback to aid debugging.

contractors.py list_contractors mixes vendor_admin filter and include_disabled — vendor_admin can never see ?include_disabled=true (intentional?). Current code only applies disabled filter for non-vendor_admin; document this behaviour.
storage.py _upload_sync: 'except (socket.error, ftplib.all_errors)' — ftplib.all_errors is a tuple, fine here but socket.error is alias of OSError; keep as is. No issue.
Same scoped-fixture-as-instance-method PytestRemovedIn10Warning emitted (3 occurrences); migrate to @classmethod fixtures or top-level fixtures before pytest 10.
